run_text_to_image: run text-to-image generation using FalAI task with prompt and optional lora adapter weights
run_automatic_speech_recognition: run automatic speech recognition on audio file or URL and return transcribed text
run_text_to_video: run text-to-video generation using FalAI queue task with polling until completion
run_image_to_image: run image-to-image transformation using FalAI queue task with optional lora adapter
run_image_segmentation: run image segmentation using FalAI queue task and return mask as base64
